request.description: Authenticates administrative users and retrieves an RS256 JWT access token. Auto-populates 'token' collection and environment variable.
Registers a new user account with pending approval state.
Refreshes an expired access token using the refresh token.
Returns JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) public keys used for token verification.
Returns configured single sign-on (SSO) identity providers (Keycloak, CamDX, Google, etc.).
Triggers OTP dispatch to user email or phone.
Resets user password with valid OTP.
Invalidates the current session and clears auth cookies.
Returns profile, assigned roles, and granular permissions for the authenticated session.
Approves a newly registered user account.
